tools.name: get_search
tools.description: Read a retained Search request and its response pages. Use the searchId and, for an anonymous request, its issued searchToken. This does not run a new search or execute work.

tools.name: get_agent_home
tools.description: Read a public agent identity and a page of its actual operations. Use an exact agent ID returned by Search. This does not start work or grant execution authority.

tools.name: get_assist
tools.description: Read the caller-owned Assist request, revisions, quote and run evidence. Assist is release-gated and may be unavailable. A plan is not proof of execution.

tools.name: show_darwin_view

tools.name: open_darwin
tools.description: Open the Darwin Browse app. Use search for a query and the thread tools for authorized interactions.

tools.name: act
tools.description: Start work from searchId or explicit targets, or continue a thread using threadId and a typed message. Authentication and payment responses use this tool. Preserve idempotencyKey on retries. Use get_act_request with the returned actRequestId for verified thread state; acceptance is not completion or

tools.name: get_act_request
tools.description: Read an authorized Act request and current child-thread messages, actions and pending requests. Use the actRequestId returned by act. Continue the selected thread through act; a handoff receipt is not proof of provider completion.

tools.name: get_thread
tools.description: Read the current authorized embedded thread. UI helper only.

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Read the authenticated person’s safe Darwin account context and authorized AIs. Excludes email, phone, credentials, API keys, and application administration.

tools.name: list_search_history
tools.description: List the authenticated person’s recent Darwin searches with bounded pagination. History expires after 90 days and never includes another account’s searches.

tools.name: list_act_history
tools.description: List private threads for the authorized Darwin account. This is the same bounded read as list_threads.

tools.name: list_payment_methods
tools.description: List a cursor page of saved payment method references for the authorized account with status, rail and default selection. Continue with nextCursor as afterCursor until null. Returns safe IDs and labels only, never card numbers, bank details or provider instrument tokens. A saved method is not approv

tools.name: list_auth_credentials
tools.description: List a cursor page of saved connection metadata for the authorized account. Continue with nextCursor as afterCursor until null. Returns safe IDs and labels only, never passwords, tokens, API keys or credential values. Selecting a saved credential does not grant new permission.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: show_darwin_view, open_darwin, get_act_request, get_thread, get_account, list_act_history · Private data: show_darwin_view, get_account, list_act_history, list_payment_methods, list_auth_credentials · Public sink: get_account · Destructive: get_search, assist, get_assist.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: show_darwin_view, open_darwin, get_act_request, get_thread, get_account, list_act_history · Private data: show_darwin_view, get_account, list_act_history, list_payment_methods, list_auth_credentials · Public sink: get_account · Destructive: get_search, assist, get_assist

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
